def atomic_write_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".partial")
    with temporary.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    os.replace(temporary, path)

def atomic_torch_save(payload: dict[str, Any], path: Path) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".partial")
    torch.save(payload, temporary)
    os.replace(temporary, path)

def fold_for_job(evaluation_mode: str, outer_entity: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    fold = fold_membership.loc[
        fold_membership["evaluation_mode"].eq(evaluation_mode)
        & fold_membership["outer_entity"].eq(str(outer_entity))
    ].copy()
    require(not fold.empty, f"No fold membership for {evaluation_mode}:{outer_entity}")
    require(fold["canonical_cell_id"].is_unique, f"Duplicate cell rows in {evaluation_mode}:{outer_entity}")
    return fold

definitions.name: source_blocked_role_payload
definitions.source:
def source_blocked_role_payload(evaluation_mode: str, outer_entity: str, inner_fold: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require(evaluation_mode == "LODO", "Revised Stage 6 accepts LODO jobs only")
    require(str(outer_entity) in STAGE6_ALL_OUTER_SOURCES, f"Unknown outer source: {outer_entity}")
    require(int(inner_fold) in INNER_FOLDS, f"Invalid source block: {inner_fold}")
    fold = fold_for_job(evaluation_mode, outer_entity)
    development = fold.loc[fold["split"].eq("development")].copy()
    test = fold.loc[fold["split"].eq("test")].copy()
    forbidden = fold.loc[~fold["split"].eq("development")].copy()
    family_partition_counts = fold.groupby("duplicate_family_id")["split"].nunique(dropna=False)
    require(
        family_partition_counts.eq(1).all(),
        "Duplicate family spans multiple fold partitions",
    )
    require(not development.empty and not test.empty, "Outer development/test partition is empty")
    outer_rows = fold.loc[fold["source"].astype(str).eq(str(outer_entity))]
    require(not outer_rows.empty, "Outer source has no membership rows")
    require(outer_rows["split"].eq("test").all(), "Not every outer-source cell is sealed in test")
    if "direct_test_member" in fold.columns:
        direct_test = fold.loc[normalize_bool(fold["direct_test_member"], "direct_test_member")]
        require(set(direct_test["source"].astype(str)) == {str(outer_entity)}, "Direct test membership is not exactly the outer source")
    require(not development["source"].astype(str).eq(str(outer_entity)).any(), "Outer source leaked into development")

    expected_development_sources = set(STAGE6_ALL_OUTER_SOURCES) - {str(outer_entity)}
    observed_development_sources = set(development["source"].astype(str))
    require(
        observed_development_sources == expected_development_sources,
        f"Development source coverage mismatch for outer={outer_entity}: "
        f"missing={sorted(expected_development_sources - observed_development_sources)}, "
        f"extra={sorted(observed_development_sources - expected_development_sources)}",
    )

    validation_sources = set(SOURCE_BLOCKS[int(inner_fold)]) - {str(outer_entity)}
    expected_train_sources = expected_development_sources - validation_sources
    require(3 <= len(validation_sources) <= 4, "Validation must hold 3 or 4 complete sources")
    validation = development.loc[development["source"].isin(validation_sources)].copy()
    train_before_purge = development.loc[development["source"].isin(expected_train_sources)].copy()
    require(set(validation["source"].astype(str)) == validation_sources, "A held-out validation source lacks development cells")
    require(set(train_before_purge["source"].astype(str)) == expected_train_sources, "A training source lacks development cells")

    validation_families = set(validation["duplicate_family_id"].astype(str))
    purge_mask = train_before_purge["duplicate_family_id"].astype(str).isin(validation_families)
    purged = train_before_purge.loc[purge_mask].copy()
    train = train_before_purge.loc[~purge_mask].copy()
    require(not train.empty, "Inner train is empty after cross-source duplicate-family purge")
    require(
        set(train["source"].astype(str)) == expected_train_sources,
        "Cross-source duplicate-family purge removed every cell from a training source",
    )

    train_cells = set(train["canonical_cell_id"].astype(str))
    validation_cells = set(validation["canonical_cell_id"].astype(str))
    purged_cells = set(purged["canonical_cell_id"].astype(str))
    train_families = set(train["duplicate_family_id"].astype(str))
    forbidden_cells = set(forbidden["canonical_cell_id"].astype(str))
    source_overlap = set(train["source"].astype(str)) & validation_sources
    train_protocols = set(train["protocol_id"].dropna().astype(str)) if "protocol_id" in train.columns else set()
    validation_protocols = set(validation["protocol_id"].dropna().astype(str)) if "protocol_id" in validation.columns else set()
    require(not (train_cells & validation_cells), "Cell leakage between inner train and validation")
    require(not (train_families & validation_families), "Duplicate-family leakage after train-side purge")
    require(not source_overlap, "Source leakage between inner train and validation")
    require(not ((train_cells | validation_cells) & forbidden_cells), "Inner roles touched calibration/test cells")
    require(
        train_cells | validation_cells | purged_cells == set(development["canonical_cell_id"].astype(str)),
        "Train, validation, and explicit purge do not account for every development cell",
    )
    require(
        validation_cells == set(development.loc[development["source"].isin(validation_sources), "canonical_cell_id"].astype(str)),
        "Validation is not the complete development subset of its held-out sources",
    )

    return {
        "selection_train": train_cells,
        "early_validation": validation_cells,
        "purged_train_cells": purged_cells,
        "train_sources": set(train["source"].astype(str)),
        "validation_sources": validation_sources,
        "audit": {
            "outer_entity": str(outer_entity),
            "inner_fold": int(inner_fold),
            "train_sources": sorted(set(train["source"].astype(str))),
            "validation_sources": sorted(validation_sources),
            "train_cells": len(train_cells),
            "validation_cells": len(validation_cells),
            "purged_train_cells": len(purged_cells),
            "purged_train_families": int(purged["duplicate_family_id"].astype(str).nunique()),
            "purged_train_cells_by_source": {
                str(key): int(value)
                for key, value in purged.groupby("source")["canonical_cell_id"].nunique().sort_index().items()
            },
            "cell_overlap": len(train_cells & validation_cells),
            "family_overlap_after_purge": len(train_families & validation_families),
            "source_overlap": len(source_overlap),
            "forbidden_calibration_or_test_cells_touched": len((train_cells | validation_cells) & forbidden_cells),
            "duplicate_family_single_partition": True,
            "outer_test_family_spillover_sources": sorted(set(test["source"].astype(str)) - {str(outer_entity)}),
            "train_protocol_count": len(train_protocols),
            "validation_protocol_count": len(validation_protocols),
            "shared_protocol_count_diagnostic_only": len(train_protocols & validation_protocols),
            "validation_is_complete_source_subset": True,
        },
    }

    return list(pq.read_schema(path).names)

definitions.name: read_for_cells

def read_for_cells(path: Path, columns: list[str], cell_ids: set[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    require(cell_ids, f"Empty cell selection for {path.name}")
    available = set(parquet_columns(path))
    missing = sorted(set(columns) - available)
    require(not missing, f"{path.name} is missing columns: {missing}")
    dataset = ds.dataset(str(path), format="parquet")
    table = dataset.to_table(
        columns=columns,
        filter=ds.field("canonical_cell_id").isin(sorted(cell_ids)),
    )
    frame = table.to_pandas()
    frame["canonical_cell_id"] = frame["canonical_cell_id"].astype(str)
    return frame

def validate_numeric_frame(frame: pd.DataFrame, columns: list[str], table_name: str) -> None:
    non_numeric = [name for name in columns if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(frame[name].dtype)]
    require(not non_numeric, f"{table_name} contains non-numeric predictor columns: {non_numeric[:20]}")
    values = frame[columns].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64, copy=False)
    require(not np.isinf(values).any(), f"{table_name} contains infinite predictor values")

definitions.name: resolve_cycle_shard
definitions.source:
def resolve_cycle_shard(canonical_cell_id: str) -> Path:
    require(cycle_store_index is not None, "Cycle-store index has not been loaded")
    require(canonical_cell_id in cycle_store_index.index, f"No cycle-store row for {canonical_cell_id}")
    row = cycle_store_index.loc[canonical_cell_id]
    candidates: list[Path] = []
    if "shard_relpath" in row.index and pd.notna(row["shard_relpath"]):
        candidates.append(PHASE2_DIR / str(row["shard_relpath"]))
    recorded = Path(str(row["shard_path"]))
    candidates.extend([recorded, MULTISENSOR_STORE_DIR / recorded.name])
    existing = [path for path in candidates if path.is_file()]
    require(existing, f"Cannot resolve exact cycle shard for {canonical_cell_id}; checked={candidates}")
    return existing[0]

definitions.name: load_cycle_shard
definitions.source:
def load_cycle_shard(canonical_cell_id: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    path = resolve_cycle_shard(canonical_cell_id)
    columns = list(dict.fromkeys(["canonical_cell_id", "cycle_index", *VALUE_CHANNELS, *VALUE_MASK_COLUMNS]))
    frame = pd.read_parquet(path, columns=columns)
    require(frame["canonical_cell_id"].astype(str).eq(canonical_cell_id).all(), f"Shard identity mismatch: {path}")
    require(frame["cycle_index"].is_unique, f"Duplicate cycle_index in {path}")
    frame = frame.sort_values("cycle_index", kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)
    validate_numeric_frame(frame, VALUE_CHANNELS, path.name)
    masks = frame[VALUE_MASK_COLUMNS].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64, copy=False)
    require(np.isfinite(masks).all() and np.isin(masks, [0.0, 1.0]).all(), f"Invalid cycle masks in {path}")
    values = frame[VALUE_CHANNELS].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64, copy=False)
    require(np.array_equal(np.isfinite(values), masks.astype(bool)), f"Cycle value/mask mismatch in {path}")
    return frame

definitions.name: wilson_interval
regression_metrics
definitions.source:
def regression_metrics(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    y_true: np.ndarray,
    y_pred: np.ndarray,
    lower: np.ndarray | None = None,
    upper: np.ndarray | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=np.float64)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=np.float64)
    valid = np.isfinite(y_true) & np.isfinite(y_pred)
    if not valid.any():
        return {
            "n_samples": 0, "n_cells": 0, "n_families": 0, "n_datasets": 0,
            "mae": np.nan, "rmse": np.nan, "medae": np.nan, "r2": np.nan,
            "signed_bias": np.nan, "macro_cell_mae": np.nan, "macro_cell_rmse": np.nan,
            "macro_cell_rmsle": np.nan, "source_balanced_macro_cell_mae": np.nan,
            "source_balanced_macro_cell_rmse": np.nan, "source_balanced_macro_cell_rmsle": np.nan,
            "macro_family_mae": np.nan,
            "coverage": np.nan, "mean_interval_width": np.nan, "median_interval_width": np.nan,
            "interval_score": np.nan, "coverage_wilson_low": np.nan, "coverage_wilson_high": np.nan,
            "p_y_le_q10": np.nan, "p_y_le_q50": np.nan, "p_y_le_q90": np.nan,
            "cell_simultaneous_coverage": np.nan, "family_simultaneous_coverage": np.nan,
        }

    selected_columns = ["canonical_cell_id"] + [
        name for name in ["duplicate_family_id", "source"] if name in frame.columns
    ]
    evaluated = frame.loc[valid, selected_columns].copy()
    evaluated["y_true"] = y_true[valid]
    evaluated["y_pred"] = y_pred[valid]
    evaluated["abs_error"] = np.abs(evaluated["y_pred"] - evaluated["y_true"])
    evaluated["signed_error"] = evaluated["y_pred"] - evaluated["y_true"]
    evaluated["squared_error"] = (evaluated["y_pred"] - evaluated["y_true"]) ** 2
    evaluated["log_squared_error"] = np.nan
    nonnegative = evaluated["y_true"].ge(0.0) & evaluated["y_pred"].ge(0.0)
    evaluated.loc[nonnegative, "log_squared_error"] = (
        np.log1p(evaluated.loc[nonnegative, "y_pred"])
        - np.log1p(evaluated.loc[nonnegative, "y_true"])
    ) ** 2
    cell_mae = evaluated.groupby("canonical_cell_id")["abs_error"].mean()
    cell_rmse = np.sqrt(evaluated.groupby("canonical_cell_id")["squared_error"].mean())
    cell_rmsle = np.sqrt(evaluated.groupby("canonical_cell_id")["log_squared_error"].mean())
    if "source" in evaluated:
        source_cell = (
            evaluated.groupby(["source", "canonical_cell_id"], as_index=False)
            .agg(
                cell_mae=("abs_error", "mean"),
                cell_mse=("squared_error", "mean"),
                cell_log_mse=("log_squared_error", "mean"),
            )
            .assign(
                cell_rmse=lambda table: np.sqrt(table["cell_mse"]),
                cell_rmsle=lambda table: np.sqrt(table["cell_log_mse"]),
            )
        )
        source_balanced_macro_cell_mae = float(source_cell.groupby("source")["cell_mae"].mean().mean())
        source_balanced_macro_cell_rmse = float(source_cell.groupby("source")["cell_rmse"].mean().mean())
        source_balanced_macro_cell_rmsle = float(source_cell.groupby("source")["cell_rmsle"].mean().mean())
    else:
        source_balanced_macro_cell_mae = float(cell_mae.mean())
        source_balanced_macro_cell_rmse = float(cell_rmse.mean())
        source_balanced_macro_cell_rmsle = float(cell_rmsle.mean())
    family_mae = np.nan
    if "duplicate_family_id" in evaluated:
        family_mae = float(evaluated.groupby("duplicate_family_id")["abs_error"].mean().mean())

    r2 = np.nan
    if len(evaluated) >= 2 and float(np.var(evaluated["y_true"].to_numpy())) > 0.0:
        r2 = float(r2_score(evaluated["y_true"], evaluated["y_pred"]))

    coverage = mean_width = median_width = interval_score = np.nan
    coverage_wilson_low = coverage_wilson_high = np.nan
    p_y_le_q10 = p_y_le_q50 = p_y_le_q90 = np.nan
    cell_simultaneous = family_simultaneous = np.nan
    if lower is not None and upper is not None:
        lower = np.asarray(lower, dtype=np.float64)[valid]
        upper = np.asarray(upper, dtype=np.float64)[valid]
        interval_valid = np.isfinite(lower) & np.isfinite(upper) & (lower <= upper)
        if interval_valid.any():
            truth = evaluated["y_true"].to_numpy()[interval_valid]
            widths = upper[interval_valid] - lower[interval_valid]
            covered = (truth >= lower[interval_valid]) & (truth <= upper[interval_valid])
            coverage = float(np.mean(covered))
            mean_width = float(np.mean(widths))
            median_width = float(np.median(widths))
            misses_low = np.maximum(lower[interval_valid] - truth, 0.0)
            misses_high = np.maximum(truth - upper[interval_valid], 0.0)
            interval_score = float(np.mean(widths + (2.0 / CQR_ALPHA) * (misses_low + misses_high)))
            coverage_wilson_low, coverage_wilson_high = wilson_interval(int(covered.sum()), int(len(covered)))
            p_y_le_q10 = float(np.mean(truth <= lower[interval_valid]))
            p_y_le_q50 = float(np.mean(truth <= evaluated["y_pred"].to_numpy()[interval_valid]))
            p_y_le_q90 = float(np.mean(truth <= upper[interval_valid]))
            interval_rows = evaluated.iloc[np.flatnonzero(interval_valid)].copy()
            interval_rows["covered"] = covered
            cell_simultaneous = float(interval_rows.groupby("canonical_cell_id")["covered"].all().mean())
            if "duplicate_family_id" in interval_rows:
                family_simultaneous = float(interval_rows.groupby("duplicate_family_id")["covered"].all().mean())

    return {
        "n_samples": int(len(evaluated)),
        "n_cells": int(evaluated["canonical_cell_id"].nunique()),
        "n_families": int(evaluated["duplicate_family_id"].nunique()) if "duplicate_family_id" in evaluated else 0,
        "n_datasets": int(evaluated["source"].nunique()) if "source" in evaluated else 0,
        "mae": float(evaluated["abs_error"].mean()),
        "rmse": float(np.sqrt(evaluated["squared_error"].mean())),
        "medae": float(evaluated["abs_error"].median()),
        "r2": r2,
        "signed_bias": float(evaluated["signed_error"].mean()),
        "macro_cell_mae": float(cell_mae.mean()),
        "macro_cell_rmse": float(cell_rmse.mean()),
        "macro_cell_rmsle": float(cell_rmsle.mean()),
        "source_balanced_macro_cell_mae": source_balanced_macro_cell_mae,
        "source_balanced_macro_cell_rmse": source_balanced_macro_cell_rmse,
        "source_balanced_macro_cell_rmsle": source_balanced_macro_cell_rmsle,
        "macro_family_mae": family_mae,
        "coverage": coverage,
        "mean_interval_width": mean_width,
        "median_interval_width": median_width,
        "interval_score": interval_score,
        "coverage_wilson_low": coverage_wilson_low,
        "coverage_wilson_high": coverage_wilson_high,
        "p_y_le_q10": p_y_le_q10,
        "p_y_le_q50": p_y_le_q50,
        "p_y_le_q90": p_y_le_q90,
        "cell_simultaneous_coverage": cell_simultaneous,
        "family_simultaneous_coverage": family_simultaneous,
    }

definitions.name: per_cell_error_table
definitions.source:
def per_cell_error_table(frame: pd.DataFrame, y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray) -> pd.DataFrame:
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=np.float64)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=np.float64)
    valid = np.isfinite(y_true) & np.isfinite(y_pred)
    required = ["canonical_cell_id", "duplicate_family_id", "source"]
    require(set(required).issubset(frame.columns), f"Per-cell metrics require columns: {required}")
    work = frame.loc[valid, required].copy()
    work["abs_error"] = np.abs(y_pred[valid] - y_true[valid])
    work["squared_error"] = (y_pred[valid] - y_true[valid]) ** 2
    work["signed_error"] = y_pred[valid] - y_true[valid]
    work["log_squared_error"] = np.nan
    nonnegative = (y_true[valid] >= 0.0) & (y_pred[valid] >= 0.0)
    work.loc[nonnegative, "log_squared_error"] = (
        np.log1p(y_pred[valid][nonnegative]) - np.log1p(y_true[valid][nonnegative])
    ) ** 2
    return (
        work.groupby(required, as_index=False)
        .agg(
            n_samples=("abs_error", "size"),
            cell_mae=("abs_error", "mean"),
            cell_mse=("squared_error", "mean"),
            cell_log_mse=("log_squared_error", "mean"),
            cell_signed_bias=("signed_error", "mean"),
        )
        .assign(
            cell_rmse=lambda table: np.sqrt(table["cell_mse"]),
            cell_rmsle=lambda table: np.sqrt(table["cell_log_mse"]),
        )
        .drop(columns=["cell_mse", "cell_log_mse"])
    )

definitions.name: evenly_spaced_indices
fit_cycle_scaler
definitions.source:
def fit_cycle_scaler(train_cell_ids: set[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Fit value-channel state from a deterministic, per-cell capped train-only reservoir."""
    sums = np.zeros(48, dtype=np.float64)
    squared_sums = np.zeros(48, dtype=np.float64)
    counts = np.zeros(48, dtype=np.int64)
    reservoir_rows = 0
    for ordinal, cell_id in enumerate(sorted(train_cell_ids), start=1):
        shard = load_cycle_shard(cell_id)
        selected = evenly_spaced_indices(len(shard), TCN_SCALER_POINTS_PER_CELL)
        values = shard.iloc[selected][VALUE_CHANNELS].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64, copy=False)
        masks = shard.iloc[selected][VALUE_MASK_COLUMNS].to_numpy(dtype=np.uint8, copy=False).astype(bool)
        valid = masks & np.isfinite(values)
        safe = np.where(valid, values, 0.0)
        sums += safe.sum(axis=0)
        squared_sums += (safe * safe).sum(axis=0)
        counts += valid.sum(axis=0)
        reservoir_rows += len(selected)
        del shard, values, masks, valid, safe
        if ordinal % 100 == 0:
            gc.collect()
    inactive = counts == 0
    if inactive.any():
        print(
            "[WARN] Inner-train has no valid observations for optional channels; "
            "their values remain zero and masks remain zero: "
            f"{[VALUE_CHANNELS[index] for index in np.flatnonzero(inactive)]}"
        )
    safe_counts = np.maximum(counts, 1)
    mean = sums / safe_counts
    variance = np.maximum(squared_sums / safe_counts - mean * mean, 0.0)
    mean[inactive] = 0.0
    std = np.sqrt(variance)
    std = np.where(np.isfinite(std) & (std > 1e-8), std, 1.0)
    return {
        "fit_role": "inner_train_cells_only",
        "fit_cell_count": len(train_cell_ids),
        "fit_cell_hash": sha256_json(sorted(train_cell_ids)),
        "reservoir_rule": f"at_most_{TCN_SCALER_POINTS_PER_CELL}_evenly_spaced_cycles_per_cell",
        "reservoir_rows": int(reservoir_rows),
        "channels": VALUE_CHANNELS,
        "mean": mean.tolist(),
        "std": std.tolist(),
        "count": counts.tolist(),
        "inactive_channels": [VALUE_CHANNELS[index] for index in np.flatnonzero(inactive)],
    }

definitions.name: load_multitask_window_targets
definitions.source:
def load_multitask_window_targets(cell_ids: set[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    columns = list(dict.fromkeys(METADATA_COLUMNS + TARGET_COLUMNS))
    targets = read_for_cells(TARGET_INDEX_PATH, columns, cell_ids)
    eligible_any = pd.Series(False, index=targets.index, dtype=bool)
    for target, spec in TARGET_SPECS.items():
        values = pd.to_numeric(targets[spec["y_col"]], errors="coerce")
        observed = normalize_bool(targets[spec["mask_col"]], spec["mask_col"]) & np.isfinite(values)
        if target.startswith("rul"):
            require((values.loc[observed] >= 0.0).all(), f"{target}: observed targets contain negative RUL")
        targets[spec["y_col"]] = values.astype(np.float32)
        targets[spec["mask_col"]] = observed.astype(bool)
        eligible_any |= observed
    targets = targets.loc[eligible_any].copy()
    require(not targets.empty, "Selected inner role has no sample with any observed task")
    windows = read_for_cells(WINDOW_INDEX_PATH, ["sample_id", "canonical_cell_id", "t_cycle"], cell_ids)
    require(windows["sample_id"].is_unique, "Selected window sample_id values are not unique")
    merged = targets.merge(
        windows,
        on=["sample_id", "canonical_cell_id", "t_cycle"],
        how="inner",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )
    require(len(merged) == len(targets), f"Multitask target/window join lost {len(targets) - len(merged)} rows")
    require(merged["sample_id"].is_unique, "Multitask target/window sample_id values are not unique")
    return merged.sort_values(["canonical_cell_id", "t_cycle"], kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

def fit_target_scaler(train_rows: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, Any]:
    state: dict[str, Any] = {
        "fit_role": "inner_train_observed_targets_only",
        "fit_cell_hash": sha256_json(sorted(train_rows["canonical_cell_id"].astype(str).unique().tolist())),
        "reservoir_rule": f"at_most_{TCN_TARGET_POINTS_PER_CELL}_evenly_spaced_observed_targets_per_cell",
        "targets": {},
    }
    for target in TCN_TARGET_ORDER:
        spec = TARGET_SPECS[target]
        sampled: list[np.ndarray] = []
        sampled_cells = 0
        for _, group in train_rows.groupby("canonical_cell_id", sort=True):
            observed = normalize_bool(group[spec["mask_col"]], spec["mask_col"]).to_numpy()
            values = group[spec["y_col"]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
            observed_values = values[observed & np.isfinite(values)]
            if observed_values.size == 0:
                continue
            chosen = evenly_spaced_indices(len(observed_values), TCN_TARGET_POINTS_PER_CELL)
            sampled.append(transform_target_array(observed_values[chosen], target))
            sampled_cells += 1
        if not sampled:
            state["targets"][target] = {
                "transform": TARGET_SPECS[target]["transform"],
                "mean": 0.0,
                "std": 1.0,
                "reservoir_rows": 0,
                "observed_cells": 0,
                "active": False,
                "reason": "no_observed_target_in_locked_inner_train",
            }
            continue
        reservoir = np.concatenate(sampled)
        mean = float(np.mean(reservoir))
        std = float(np.std(reservoir))
        if not np.isfinite(std) or std <= 1e-8:
            std = 1.0
        state["targets"][target] = {
            "transform": TARGET_SPECS[target]["transform"],
            "mean": mean,
            "std": std,
            "reservoir_rows": int(len(reservoir)),
            "observed_cells": int(sampled_cells),
            "active": True,
            "reason": "",
        }
    return state

def make_window_inputs(cycle_frame: pd.DataFrame, sample_frame: pd.DataFrame, scaler: dict[str, Any]) -> np.ndarray:
    cycles = cycle_frame["cycle_index"].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    require(len(cycles) > 0 and np.all(np.diff(cycles) > 0), "Cycle shard index must be non-empty and strictly increasing")
    values = cycle_frame[VALUE_CHANNELS].to_numpy(dtype=np.float32, copy=False)
    masks = cycle_frame[VALUE_MASK_COLUMNS].to_numpy(dtype=np.uint8, copy=False)
    t_cycles = sample_frame["t_cycle"].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
    grid = t_cycles[:, None] - np.arange(29, -1, -1, dtype=np.int64)[None, :]
    positions = np.searchsorted(cycles, grid)
    safe_positions = np.minimum(positions, len(cycles) - 1)
    observed = (positions < len(cycles)) & (cycles[safe_positions] == grid)
    require(observed[:, -1].all(), "A TCN sample is missing its causal endpoint cycle t")
    raw_values = values[safe_positions]
    raw_masks = masks[safe_positions].astype(bool) & observed[:, :, None]
    valid = raw_masks & np.isfinite(raw_values)
    mean = np.asarray(scaler["mean"], dtype=np.float32)[None, None, :]
    std = np.asarray(scaler["std"], dtype=np.float32)[None, None, :]
    standardized = np.zeros(raw_values.shape, dtype=np.float32)
    z_values = (raw_values - mean) / std
    standardized[valid] = z_values[valid]
    logical_window = np.concatenate([standardized, raw_masks.astype(np.float32)], axis=2)
    require(logical_window.shape[1:] == (30, 96), f"Invalid logical TCN batch shape: {logical_window.shape}")
    require(np.isfinite(logical_window).all(), "TCN input contains NaN/inf after masked standardization")
    return logical_window

definitions.source:
def encode_multitask_targets(sample_frame: pd.DataFrame, target_scaler: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    y = np.zeros((len(sample_frame), len(TCN_TARGET_ORDER)), dtype=np.float32)
    masks = np.zeros_like(y, dtype=bool)
    for target_index, target in enumerate(TCN_TARGET_ORDER):
        spec = TARGET_SPECS[target]
        values = sample_frame[spec["y_col"]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
        active = bool(target_scaler["targets"][target].get("active", True))
        observed = (
            normalize_bool(sample_frame[spec["mask_col"]], spec["mask_col"]).to_numpy()
            & np.isfinite(values)
            & active
        )
        if observed.any():
            transformed = transform_target_array(values[observed], target)
            state = target_scaler["targets"][target]
            y[observed, target_index] = ((transformed - state["mean"]) / state["std"]).astype(np.float32)
            masks[observed, target_index] = True
    require(masks.any(axis=1).all(), "A multitask batch contains a row without any observed target")
    require(np.isfinite(y).all(), "Encoded multitask targets contain NaN/inf")
    return y, masks

def multitask_pinball_loss(
    predictions: dict[str, "torch.Tensor"],
    targets: "torch.Tensor",
    observed_masks: "torch.Tensor",
) -> tuple["torch.Tensor", dict[str, float]]:
    quantiles = torch.tensor(TCN_QUANTILES, device=targets.device, dtype=torch.float32).view(1, -1)
    weighted_loss: torch.Tensor | None = None
    active_weight = 0.0
    task_losses: dict[str, float] = {}
    for target_index, target in enumerate(TCN_TARGET_ORDER):
        observed = observed_masks[:, target_index].bool()
        if not bool(observed.any()):
            continue
        prediction = predictions[target][observed].float()
        truth = targets[observed, target_index].float().view(-1, 1)
        error = truth - prediction
        task_loss = torch.maximum(quantiles * error, (quantiles - 1.0) * error).mean()
        weight = float(TCN_TASK_WEIGHTS[target])
        weighted_loss = task_loss * weight if weighted_loss is None else weighted_loss + task_loss * weight
        active_weight += weight
        task_losses[target] = float(task_loss.detach().cpu())
    if weighted_loss is None or active_weight <= 0.0:
        raise RuntimeError("A training microbatch contains no observed target")
    return weighted_loss / active_weight, task_losses

def write_checkpoint_integrity(checkpoint_path: Path, checkpoint_role: str) -> None:
    require(checkpoint_path.is_file(), f"Checkpoint is missing: {checkpoint_path}")
    atomic_write_json(checkpoint_integrity_path(checkpoint_path), {
        "checkpoint_path": str(checkpoint_path),
        "checkpoint_role": checkpoint_role,
        "size_bytes": int(checkpoint_path.stat().st_size),
        "sha256": sha256_file(checkpoint_path),
        "pipeline_config_hash": PIPELINE_CONFIG_HASH,
        "input_hashes_sha256": sha256_json(INPUT_HASHES),

    })

def select_tcn_inner_epoch(
    train_iterator: MultitaskCycleWindowIterator,
    validation_iterator: MultitaskCycleWindowIterator,
    best_checkpoint_path: Path,
    progress_checkpoint_path: Path,
    device: "torch.device",
    fold_seed: int,
    checkpoint_metadata: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple["nn.Module", int, float, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    torch.manual_seed(fold_seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(fold_seed)
    model = MultitaskQuantileTCN().to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=TCN_LEARNING_RATE, weight_decay=TCN_WEIGHT_DECAY)
    grad_scaler = make_grad_scaler(device.type == "cuda")
    best_score = float("inf")
    best_epoch = 0
    stale_epochs = 0
    start_epoch = 1
    epoch_history: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    if progress_checkpoint_path.is_file():
        progress_integrity_ok = checkpoint_integrity_is_valid(progress_checkpoint_path)
        progress = safe_torch_load(progress_checkpoint_path, device) if progress_integrity_ok else {}
        best_required = int(progress.get("best_epoch", 0)) > 0
        best_integrity_ok = (not best_required) or checkpoint_integrity_is_valid(best_checkpoint_path)
        progress_is_consistent = (
            progress_integrity_ok
            and best_integrity_ok
            and progress.get("pipeline_config_hash") == PIPELINE_CONFIG_HASH
            and progress.get("epoch_selection_metric") == TCN_EPOCH_SELECTION_METRIC
        )
        if progress_is_consistent:
            model.load_state_dict(progress["model_state_dict"])
            optimizer.load_state_dict(progress["optimizer_state_dict"])
            if "grad_scaler_state_dict" in progress:
                grad_scaler.load_state_dict(progress["grad_scaler_state_dict"])
            start_epoch = int(progress["epoch"]) + 1
            best_score = float(progress["best_validation_rul90_macro_cell_rmsle"])
            best_epoch = int(progress["best_epoch"])
            stale_epochs = int(progress["stale_epochs"])
            epoch_history = list(progress.get("epoch_history", []))
            print(f"[RESUME EPOCH] starting at epoch={start_epoch}; best_epoch={best_epoch}; metric={TCN_EPOCH_SELECTION_METRIC}")
        else:
            print("[WARN] Checkpoint hash/config/input integrity failed; this fold will restart deterministically.")

    for epoch in range(start_epoch, MAX_EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        microbatch_count = 0
        train_loss_sum = 0.0
        for x_np, y_np, mask_np, _ in train_iterator.iter_cell_balanced_microbatches(epoch=epoch):
            x = torch.from_numpy(x_np).to(device)
            y = torch.from_numpy(y_np).to(device)
            masks = torch.from_numpy(mask_np).to(device)
            with autocast_context(device):
                predictions = model(x)
            loss, _ = multitask_pinball_loss(predictions, y, masks)
            grad_scaler.scale(loss / TCN_GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS).backward()
            microbatch_count += 1
            train_loss_sum += float(loss.detach().cpu())
            if microbatch_count % TCN_GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS == 0:
                grad_scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=TCN_GRADIENT_CLIP_NORM)
                grad_scaler.step(optimizer)
                grad_scaler.update()
                optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        require(microbatch_count > 0, "TCN cell-balanced iterator produced no microbatches")
        require(microbatch_count % TCN_GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS == 0, "Effective batch ended with an incomplete accumulation group")
        validation_score, validation_details = evaluate_tcn_rul90_macro_cell_rmsle(
            model, validation_iterator, validation_iterator.target_scaler, device
        )
        train_loss = float(train_loss_sum / microbatch_count)
        epoch_history.append({
            "epoch": int(epoch),
            "train_multitask_pinball": train_loss,
            "epoch_selection_metric": TCN_EPOCH_SELECTION_METRIC,
            "validation_rul90_source_balanced_macro_cell_rmsle": float(validation_score),
            "rul90_cells": int(validation_details["rul90_cells"]),
            "rul90_sources": int(validation_details["rul90_sources"]),
        })
        print(
            f"[TCN INNER EPOCH] epoch={epoch} train_loss={train_loss:.6g} "
            f"{TCN_EPOCH_SELECTION_METRIC}={validation_score:.6g} details={validation_details}"
        )
        if validation_score < best_score - TCN_MINIMUM_IMPROVEMENT:
            best_score = validation_score
            best_epoch = epoch
            stale_epochs = 0
            atomic_torch_save({
                "model_state_dict": {name: value.detach().cpu() for name, value in model.state_dict().items()},
                "best_epoch": best_epoch,
                "best_validation_rul90_macro_cell_rmsle": best_score,
                "epoch_selection_metric": TCN_EPOCH_SELECTION_METRIC,
                "epoch_selection_details": validation_details,
                "epoch_history": epoch_history,
                "pipeline_config_hash": PIPELINE_CONFIG_HASH,
                **checkpoint_metadata,
            }, best_checkpoint_path)
            write_checkpoint_integrity(best_checkpoint_path, "best")
        else:
            stale_epochs += 1
        atomic_torch_save({
            "model_state_dict": {name: value.detach().cpu() for name, value in model.state_dict().items()},
            "optimizer_state_dict": optimizer.state_dict(),
            "grad_scaler_state_dict": grad_scaler.state_dict(),
            "epoch": epoch,
            "best_epoch": best_epoch,
            "best_validation_rul90_macro_cell_rmsle": best_score,
            "epoch_selection_metric": TCN_EPOCH_SELECTION_METRIC,
            "epoch_history": epoch_history,
            "stale_epochs": stale_epochs,
            "pipeline_config_hash": PIPELINE_CONFIG_HASH,
            **checkpoint_metadata,
        }, progress_checkpoint_path)
        write_checkpoint_integrity(progress_checkpoint_path, "progress")
        if stale_epochs >= PATIENCE:
            print(f"[TCN INNER EARLY STOP] epoch={epoch} best_epoch={best_epoch}")
            break

    require(best_epoch > 0 and checkpoint_integrity_is_valid(best_checkpoint_path), "TCN failed to select an integrity-verified inner epoch")
    best_payload = safe_torch_load(best_checkpoint_path, device)
    require(best_payload.get("epoch_selection_metric") == TCN_EPOCH_SELECTION_METRIC, "TCN checkpoint metric mismatch")
    model.load_state_dict(best_payload["model_state_dict"])
    return model, int(best_epoch), float(best_score), epoch_history

definitions.source:
def predict_multitask_tcn(
    model: "nn.Module",
    iterator: MultitaskCycleWindowIterator,
    target_scaler: dict[str, Any],
    split_role: str,
    device: "torch.device",
    mode: str,
    entity: str,
    inner_fold: int,
    best_epoch: int,
) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    model.eval()
    parts: dict[str, list[pd.DataFrame]] = {target: [] for target in TCN_TARGET_ORDER}
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x_np, _, mask_np, rows in iterator.iter_prediction_batches():
            x = torch.from_numpy(x_np).to(device)
            with autocast_context(device):
                prediction_tensors = model(x)
            for target_index, target in enumerate(TCN_TARGET_ORDER):
                observed = mask_np[:, target_index].astype(bool)
                if not observed.any():
                    continue
                transformed_prediction = prediction_tensors[target].detach().float().cpu().numpy()[observed]
                prediction = inverse_scaled_target(transformed_prediction, target, target_scaler)
                require(np.isfinite(prediction).all(), f"{target}: inverse TCN predictions contain NaN/inf")
                require(
                    np.all(prediction[:, 0] <= prediction[:, 1]) and np.all(prediction[:, 1] <= prediction[:, 2]),
                    f"{target}: ordered quantile head contract was violated",
                )
                selected_rows = rows.loc[observed].reset_index(drop=True)
                y_true = selected_rows[TARGET_SPECS[target]["y_col"]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
                part = selected_rows[METADATA_COLUMNS].copy()
                part["evaluation_mode"] = mode
                part["outer_entity"] = entity
                part["inner_fold"] = int(inner_fold)
                part["target"] = target
                part["model_id"] = "quantile_tcn_locked"
                part["split_role"] = split_role
                part["best_epoch"] = int(best_epoch)
                part["y_true"] = y_true.astype(np.float32)
                part["q10"] = prediction[:, 0].astype(np.float32)
                part["q50"] = prediction[:, 1].astype(np.float32)
                part["q90"] = prediction[:, 2].astype(np.float32)
                part["pipeline_config_hash"] = PIPELINE_CONFIG_HASH
                parts[target].append(part)
    outputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame] = {}
    for target, target_parts in parts.items():
        if not target_parts:
            outputs[target] = pd.DataFrame()
            continue
        output = pd.concat(target_parts, ignore_index=True)
        require(output["sample_id"].is_unique, f"TCN predictions are not unique for {target}:{split_role}")
        outputs[target] = output
    return outputs
